# Carl Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine years old (Volume 5)  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Carl has clear, bright, dark-blue eyes, and brown hair with glints of gold. He has a habit of sleeping in an old cot that is too short for his height.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Carl is an inquisitive, nature-loving boy who is fascinated by bugs, frogs, ants, and other small creatures. He possesses a strong curiosity, often carrying live specimens in his pockets to study. Although quiet and meditative at times, he is fearless when exploring nature, though he can be susceptible to frightening ghost stories.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c4 P14](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0014), [v5 c8 P27](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0027), [v5 c30 P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000)_

- To explore African jungles when he grows up  <sub>[v5 c35 P13](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0013)</sub>

## History

Carl Meredith moved to the Glen St. Mary manse with his widowed father, John Knox Meredith, his aunt Martha, and his three siblings. He quickly befriended the Blythe children of Ingleside, sharing playtimes in Rainbow Valley. One spring, he participated in a play fight in an old barn and helped hide the runaway girl, Mary Vance, sharing his meals and adventures with her. Later that year, he threw a cat-frightening eel into a buggy as part of a dare, leading his father to attempt to punish him. After feeling guilty for his actions, Carl volunteered to sit alone in a graveyard at night as a self-imposed penance for his cowardice during a ghost scare in Rainbow Valley; the prolonged exposure to a cold rain resulted in a severe case of double pneumonia from which he eventually recovered. He later joined his siblings and friends in welcoming his new stepmother, Rosemary West.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P7](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0007), [v5 c2 P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c5 P13](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0013), [v5 c30 P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000), [v5 c31 P8](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0008), [v5 c31 P19](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0019), [v5 c33 P16](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0016), [v5 c33 P29](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0029), [v5 c35 P10](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0010)_
